output_policy: The client does not read or override project audio settings. Its prepared input comes from the public DB reader. No host channel configuration or default route.
timing_policy: The client has no playback clock. It accepts monitor frames only when their source timebase matches the prepared source clip; UI repaint is a passive wake-up, not cadence.
process_policy: One player child on the client workstation, prepared off the UI thread. Commands and state use authenticated qnc-player+tcp socket transport. RGBA monitor frames use qnc-player-frame-map latest-frame transport so slow UI paint drops stale pictures instead of blocking playback. Source media keeps its Local/LAN/Intranet binding. Latest selection wins; no user command replay or local playback clock. After source preparation the client may request one local Cue(0) to publish the first decoded monitor frame; this is a passive monitor presentation, not probe, scan, playback clock, or UI timing. Audio belongs to the player host device, not a remote client device.
